# Major

#### Feature

- Skip TYPO3's sudo mode password dialog for users who signed in with Entra ID in the last 15 minutes (configurable with `sudoModeWindow`), so they can edit backend users and enter admin mode with Elevate to Admin
- After that time, entering admin mode asks the user to sign in again, and Microsoft asks for their credentials again

#### Breaking

- TYPO3 v12.4.32 or v13.4.13 is now required
- Users already signed in with Entra ID when this is deployed need to sign out and sign in again before sudo mode is skipped for them
